items.rationale: Accept easy. Tren, Tramvai and Metrou share the concrete rail-running predicate; Bicicletă does not. The three rail modes are independently familiar, with no competing trio as specific as the intended one.

Accept easy. Rain, snow and hail are familiar precipitation forms; wolf is a clear biological outsider. This is a deliberately accessible first-step classification, without an obscure exception or changing fact.

Accept easy. Cheek, eyelid and eyebrow are parts of the face; knee is a lower-limb part. All four are familiar body words, so the distinction requires the actual relation instead of recognition of only three words.
Accept easy. Thigh, lower leg and ankle are parts of the lower limb; nose is facial. The terminology remains common and the anatomical predicate resolves one unique intruder.
Accept easy. Root, branch and leaf are actual plant parts. Stone may occur beside a plant but is not one of its parts; the specific part-of predicate resolves that contextual association fairly.

Accept easy. Sofa, armchair and stool are furniture intended for sitting; tap is plumbing. Their common purpose is concrete and nameable, with the backless stool giving useful variety inside the trio.
Accept easy. Hammer, pliers and saw are manual workshop tools. Toothbrush is specifically for personal hygiene, unlike the previously discussed ruler that could fairly be a workshop tool.
Accept easy. Telemea, Urdă and Brânză de burduf are familiar cheese varieties; apricot is fruit. All intended members satisfy one culinary kind rather than regional association.
Accept easy. Amandină, Ecler and Savarină are familiar confectionery cakes; mustard is a savoury condiment. The label states a recognizable retail/food type rather than a technical recipe identity.
Accept easy. Compas, Echer and Raportor are instruments in the geometry kit; Mop is a cleaning tool. The trio has a specific shared school function, with no guess-dependent exception.
Accept easy. Sink, bathtub and tap are sanitary fixtures connected to water; clock is not. A clock may stand in a bathroom, but simple co-location does not satisfy the stated plumbing predicate.
Accept easy. Mop, broom and vacuum are routinely used to clean floors; fountain pen is for writing. The predicate includes different cleaning methods without implying they all work identically.

Accept easy. Shovel, rake and watering can are tools used in a garden; toothpaste is a hygiene consumable. The word unelte reasonably covers the watering implement and does not promise three soil-cutting tools.

Accept easy. Bear, fox and squirrel are familiar wild animals of Romanian forests; the ordinary domestic sheep is the outlier. The label explicitly supplies wild status, avoiding the weak claim that sheep can never enter woodland.
Accept easy. Cow, horse and goat are domestic animals raised around farms and households; wolf is wild. The display does not imply the three have identical diet or economic use.
Accept easy. Apple, pear and plum grow in orchards; carrot is a cultivated root vegetable. The everyday food senses are clear and there is no botanical tomato-style trap.

Accept easy. Second, minute and hour are duration units; ruler measures length rather than being a duration unit. Unlike a four-group abstract filler board, this short educational contrast directly tests a useful unit/instrument distinction.

Accept easy. Wardrobe, shelf and chest of drawers store objects; shampoo is a consumable. Shampoo may be stored in that furniture, which remains a different relation and cannot make it a storage object.

Accept easy. Wheat, barley and oats are cereals; vanilla is a flavouring crop. All are familiar ingredient words and the distinction is a true kind-of relation rather than assumed sweet-versus-savoury use.

Accept easy under the exact bound identities. Walnut, hazelnut and almond supply edible kernels enclosed in hard shells. The Cacao identity is explicitly food powder, which is not such a kernel. This judgment does not extend to a substituted cacao-plant or cacao-bean identity and does not classify almonds as botanical nuts.

Accept easy. Trousers, dress and skirt are clothing; comb is a grooming implement. All are concrete everyday objects and the intended group is uniquely identifiable without a hidden brand or fashion convention.

Accept easy. Blanket, sheet and carpet are household textiles; hammer is a tool. The floor textile does not have to be bed linen, because the label correctly names the wider shared material/use class.

Accept easy. Roof, wall and ceiling form part of a house construction; motorcycle is a vehicle. The difference is about structural function, not whether an item could physically be kept inside a home.

Accept easy. Sadness, fear and anger are emotions; hunger is a physiological need. All four are commonly described feelings, so the more precise emotion label resolves the superficially plausible alternative grouping.

Accept easy. Sun, Moon and star are celestial bodies; carrot is not. The Sun also being a star creates nested membership inside the same intended category, not an alternative intruder or false scientific distinction.

Accept normal. Whipped cream/qualified whipping cream, soap/towel, bed/mattress and yeast/bread each form an ordinary functional association. The two food pairs do not support a comparably strong complete cross-matching: yeast does not make whipped cream, and whipping cream is not the defining source of bread.

Accept normal. Garcea/Mugur Mihăescu is the actor-role anchor; clock/hour and flowerpot/watering can are familiar practical pairs. Roe deer/deer are correctly paired as cervids, not falsely described as male and female of one species. No second performer or fictional role creates a mirror.

Accept normal. Popovici/swimming, bulb/light switch, train/station and Caragiale/O scrisoare pierdută are individually legible. Athlete/discipline and writer/work have different, recognizable counterpart types, so pairing the two people would strand incompatible remaining tiles.

Accept normal. Salt/brine, grandmother/grandfather, fork/spoon and Brâncuși/Domnișoara Pogany are precise enough to recover uniquely. Culinary tools and the salt solution share a broad meal context but cannot be exchanged into an equally plausible complete matching.

Accept normal. Eminescu/Floare albastră, two cheese types, two eye-area facial parts and flour/dough have clear independent relationships. Flour may occur in foods with cheese, but the displayed cheese-cheese and ingredient-dough pairs are far more specific than such co-occurrence.

Accept normal. Brother/sister, bicycle/motorcycle, hammer/nail and cloud/rain are familiar, independent pairs. The bicycle and motorcycle are the ordinary two-wheel forms; niche variants do not make the board misleading. No extra family or transport tiles permit a competing partition.

Accept normal for the displayed actor/character association. Heel/ankle, sofa/armchair and apple/pear provide clear anchors; Bobiță/Mihai Bobonete is ordinary television-role recognition. Bound KG descriptions mention a pub occupation, but neither displayed pair label nor the solution requires alcohol knowledge or adult framing; this is not permission for a pub-themed derivative.

Accept normal. Calendar/year, husband/wife, Halep/Wimbledon 2019 and barley/oats are independent. The calendar uses its ordinary annual sense; the tennis achievement is a fixed historical pairing. The additional female name cannot create a valid marriage-based alternative with the remaining event.

Accept normal. Sink/tap, book/reading, lightning/thunder and toothbrush/toothpaste are everyday counterparts. The two hygiene/water pairs retain distinctive functional partners rather than one generic bathroom category.

Accept normal with the culinary shell/kernel label. Rain/snow, wheat/semolina, skirt/dress and walnut/almond are recognizable. The milling relationship distinguishes the cereal pair from edible kernels; the wording does not assert that almonds are botanical nuts.

Accept normal. Ruler/set square, shoe/sock, bed/pillow and Creangă/Capra cu trei iezi are immediate concrete associations. School instruments do not create a second credible pairing for the writer and story, and there is only one author/work pair.

Accept normal. Mother/father, socket/plug, Porumbescu/Balada pentru vioară and minute/second are specific pairs. The two time units have an exact conversion; no second composer or music title creates the known cross-author ambiguity.

Accept normal. Wardrobe/shelf, comb/shampoo, watering can/water and pancakes/jam are legible. Water can be used while washing hair, but swapping it into that pair strands the watering can; no equally defensible complete alternative exists.

Accept normal. Knife/bread, Slavici/Moara cu noroc, Neagu/handball and cocoa/chocolate each have a clear purpose, attribution or ingredient relation. The sports statement is a stable discipline identity, without an outdated present-tense employment or retirement claim.

Accept normal. Cooker/frying pan, sarmale/cabbage, Coandă/eponymous effect and vacuum/dust are specific. Cabbage leaves are a standard sarmale wrapper; the label does not claim every sarmale recipe must use cabbage. Shared kitchen context does not support an equivalent alternative mapping.

Accept normal. Polenta/cornmeal, lower leg/knee, mujdei/garlic and Piersic/Mărgelatu pair naturally. Polenta can accompany garlic sauce, but swapping the two finished foods would leave cornmeal/garlic without a comparable defining relationship; ingredient pairs remain uniquely preferable.

Accept normal. Library/book, cup/tea, screwdriver/screw and oven/baking tray are concrete counterpart relationships. The library uses the public-place sense supported by its exact identity. Kitchen objects have different uses and do not permit an equally natural cross-matching.

Accept normal. Notebook/pen, broom/dustpan, Enescu/Rapsodia Română and Amandină/Ecler are recognizable. The composer title is kept apart from Porumbescu, avoiding the real same-title ambiguity; the remaining practical and confectionery pairs do not compete.

Accept normal. Pencil/eraser, mop/bucket, mustard/mici and window/mirror each have familiar partners. Cleaning can involve glass surfaces, but pairing a mop with a window strands bucket/mirror; the intended full matching remains the uniquely coherent one.

Accept normal. Glass/water, Racoviță/speleology, root/branch and Comăneci/first Olympic perfect ten are distinct. Water/plant association is too broad to displace glass/water while leaving an equally good match for the glass, and the two famous people have unmistakably different counterparts.

Accept easy. Stilou, Radieră and Riglă are familiar school supplies with different clear functions; Cană is a drinking vessel. A mug may occur at school, but location does not make it a school supply. The precise inlier predicate yields the strongest ordinary three-word grouping. No identical trio or near-duplicate board was found; maximum overlap with existing Intrusul boards is one word.

Accept easy. Tigaie, Oală and Castron are all vessels that hold food; Cuțit is a cutting tool. All four belong naturally in a kitchen, so the player must identify the specific vessel distinction rather than choose a thematically unrelated word. Cooking versus serving does not produce an equally precise alternative trio. None of these four words is reused in an existing Intrusul board.

Accept easy. Camion, Microbuz and Dubă use roads; Tren uses rails. The infrastructure distinction is definitional and immediately nameable. I considered goods versus passengers as an alternate reading: the generic Tren label includes both passenger and freight trains, so it does not establish an exclusive cargo trio. This is a weaker alternative than the exact road/rail split. Maximum old-board overlap is one word and the inlier trio is new.

Accept easy. Găină–Ou, Lampă–Bec, Supă–Lingură and Aeroport–Avion are familiar, distinctive everyday pairings. The last three pairs provide firm anchors; possible food associations between hen, egg and soup cannot produce a second complete defensible matching because the spoon then loses its natural partner. Labels state ordinary associations without requiring specialist exceptions. All four intended pairs are new; the graph has no on-board cross edges.

Accept easy. Dinte–Periuță de dinți, Mop–Podea, copac–Rădăcină and Cumpărături–magazin have clear functions or part/whole relationships. Dinte–Rădăcină is a real secondary association worth testing, but choosing it strands copac and Periuță de dinți; it does not yield an equally defensible complete matching. No knowledge of the hidden KG descriptions is needed. All four pairs are new, and independent graph checks confirm only the intended four on-board links.

Accept corrected v2. Școală–A învăța and Ceas–Minut provide clear activity/time anchors. Morcov–Iepure is explicitly a familiar cultural association; the wording makes no claim about an animal's necessary, preferred or healthy diet. The exact floare snapshot denotes a reproductive plant organ, so the corrected label 'Floare și recipient pentru planta ei' preserves that sense instead of falsely calling the organ a whole plant. Ghiveci de flori also disambiguates the vessel from the dish. School/clock or carrot/flower co-occurrence cannot form a credible second complete matching. All four intended pairs are new and no on-board cross edges occur.

Accept easy. Ștecher, Prelungitor electric and Cablu electric connect appliances to electrical power; Robinet controls water. The inliers include a part, a cable and a complete extension device, but all satisfy the stated functional predicate without a category switch. The four words are familiar household hardware; choosing by water versus electricity requires the intended meaning, not a person/object type shortcut. No alternative trio has an equally precise ordinary shared function. Three words are new in this game; maximum old-board overlap is one.

Accept easy. Foame, Sete and Oboseală signal ordinary bodily needs for food, water and rest, while Rușine names a social emotion. All four are states, so the odd word cannot be found by grammatical or KG type alone. Emotional and figurative uses do not yield a competing three-word physiological group in the everyday senses. This introduces three unused Intrusul words and no reused inlier trio. The statement is a language association, not a diagnostic or health instruction.

Accept easy. Bunică, Bunic and Mătușă name relatives, whereas Coleg names a shared school or work relationship. A particular colleague may also be a relative, but that overlap between people does not change the words’ definitions. All four name interpersonal roles, making the kinship criterion exact and recognizable. Gender does not create a competing trio: two female and two male forms are shown. All four visible concepts are new in Intrusul.

Accept normal. Ochi–A vedea, Dormitor–Pat and Detergent–Burete de vase provide immediate bodily, room/furniture and cleaning anchors. Stela Popescu–Alexandru Arșinel is a recognizable Romanian comedy partnership, not merely two arbitrary actors. Eye/bed sleep associations cannot complete another matching, because Dormitor then has no plausible connection to A vedea. Neither comic actor fits another displayed member better. All four intended pairs are absent from the current Perechi inventory; exact graph gates support rather than replace this semantic judgment.

Accept normal. Ureche–A auzi, Cablu electric–Prelungitor electric, Vapor–Port and Scrisoarea III–Mihai Eminescu each have a nameable function, part/device, transport destination or authorship relation. The displayed electrical qualifier rules out cable as an unrelated rope, and the maritime Port snapshot is consistent with the ship. Hearing a poem is possible but leaves Ureche and Mihai Eminescu without an equally definite alternative pairing. The four intended pairs are new, without strong on-board cross edges.

Accept normal. Curcubeu–Culoare and Calendar–Zi are accessible anchors, followed by Castelul Peleș–Sinaia and Făină–Cozonac. The castle/city connection and the culinary ingredient/preparation link are specific and familiar. Rainbow/day weather co-occurrence does not give a second complete matching: Calendar and Culoare would then have only a generic visual association. All twelve intended associations across the three Perechi boards are new; this board’s four links do not depend on hidden descriptions to become guessable.

Accept easy. Gară, Aeroport and Stație are places where transport stops; Vapor is a vehicle. The player can name the common relation from the visible words. All four are travel concepts, avoiding a subject jump or grammatical shortcut; a ship visiting a port does not turn the ship into a stopping facility. Four fresh Intrusul words and no old-board overlap.

Accept easy. Eating, drinking and cooking form a clear food-related action trio; reading does not have that lexical purpose. The label explicitly covers both preparation and consumption, so cooking is not forced into an eating-only category. All four are infinitives, and reading a recipe is only incidental context. Four fresh words and no competing equally precise trio.

Accept easy. Wind, cloud and fog describe weather; night describes a time of day. Night can be windy or foggy, so darkness is not an alternative atmospheric answer. These are common words with a clear contrast, not technical cloud taxonomy. All four are new in this game; no old trio is recycled.

Accept easy. Banana, orange and lemon are familiar fruits; carrot is the ordinary edible root. The two citrus fruits do not form an alternative group of three, and the label does not require sweetness. Banana is a useful small variation inside an accessible group. Three new game words; only carrot overlaps old stock.

Accept easy. Grape/raisin, earth/shovel, pavement/street and neck/head are immediately nameable food-transformation, tool/material, street-part and body-part associations. Earth/street or shovel/pavement are conceivable construction context, but do not provide another equally specific complete matching. All intended pairs are new; native pair enumeration has exactly one solution. The earth label correctly says moving material rather than claiming earth is itself a location.

Accept easy. Biscuit/crumb, chair/stool, week/weekend and soup/bowl give four different concrete relationships. Putting biscuits in a bowl cannot complete a persuasive alternative: soup/crumb would need an unshown crouton or bread assumption. Chair/stool contrasts the absence of a back, without claiming all chairs have arms. Ordinary words and four new pairs; no native unintended link or competing complete matching.

Accept easy. Night/sleep, fridge/freezer, mouth/lip and garment/lint are clear time/activity, appliance, body-part and material-fragment anchors. The timing wording allows daytime sleep and avoids an absolute biological claim. A mouth consumes refrigerated food only through an extra unshown ingredient, leaving the remaining terms unmatched. Four fresh intended pairs and exactly one strong-edge matching.

Accept easy. Garden/rake, carpet/vacuum, mother/baby and wolf/forest are familiar functional, care and habitat relations. Raking forest leaves is possible but swaps away the more specific garden/tool relation and leaves wolf/garden as an incidental occurrence. Vacuuming garden debris likewise does not make another sensible complete partition. The habitat label is explicitly nonexclusive; all four links are new and each is supported by the native graph.

Accept easy. Pat, Saltea and Pernă are ordinary items specifically intended for sleeping; Scaun is intended for sitting. All are domestic objects, so the answer uses function rather than a change of topic. Falling asleep in a chair is possible, but it does not give that object the same normal design purpose. The specific sleep grouping is uniquely preferable to broad furniture or soft-item observations.

Accept easy. Făină, Mălai and Griș are familiar products of milling cereals; Drojdie is a fermenting preparation. All four plausibly occur when cooking, and the shared milling process provides an exact distinction. Not every modern flour must be cereal flour, but the displayed everyday Făină identity is grain-derived flour. Yeast used with flour is an ingredient association, not a second milling classification.

Accept easy. Cameră, Sufragerie and Dormitor name interior rooms, while Curte is the outside yard. Cameră is the room sense naturally supplied by the other visible words; both ordinary dining-room and living-room senses of Sufragerie satisfy the same predicate. Therefore the prior Contexto sense problem does not affect this bounded grouping. A courtyard surrounded by buildings remains exterior rather than another furnished room.

Accept easy. Caiet, Creion and Pix are concrete school stationery used for writing; Examen is an assessment. The phrase rechizite folosite pentru scris honestly includes a writing surface as well as implements, without pretending that the notebook writes by itself. Written examinations create a broad school connection but do not turn the event into an item of stationery. No alternate precise trio displaces the intended one.

Accept easy. Caiet–Temă pentru acasă, Oboseală–A dormi, Cui–Clește and Ulei–Semințe de floarea-soarelui have specific school, rest, tool and ingredient-source relationships. Study may cause fatigue, but pairing homework with fatigue strands notebook and sleeping. Lubricating pliers with oil would leave a nail and sunflower seeds without an equally specific partner. These are common words and four new pair identities, with no credible second complete partition.

Accept easy. Frunte–Sprânceană is a familiar positional body relation; Cratiță–Aragaz, Capră–Iarbă and Lună calendaristică–Calendar are immediate cooking, plant-food and time-display matches. The goat label explicitly says one food, avoiding an exclusive-diet claim. Forehead and eyebrow refer to distinct adjacent parts, not synonyms. Imagining a pot of herbs or seasonal grazing cannot complete a competing matching with the remaining body and calendar terms.

Accept easy. A deschide–A închide supplies a clear antonym anchor, followed by Cremă de vanilie–Cremșnit, Farfurie–Burete de vase and Mână–Deget. A hand can hold a sponge and a plate can hold cake, but those swaps strand a finger with cream or another equally weak leftover. The actual filling and cleaning-purpose pairs are more distinctive. The qualified dish-sponge label avoids the fungal meaning of burete; no hidden identity is needed to guess it.

Accept easy. Gură–A vorbi, Zahăr–Zahăr pudră, Lapte–Zer and Furtun de grădină–Stropitoare have clear bodily, ingredient-form, processing and watering relationships. The sugar and milk pairs are two distinct culinary relations, and swapping them would force sugar with whey merely because both can appear in food. The garden qualifier prevents an unrelated hose meaning. Zer is the least frequent word but remains ordinary Romanian food vocabulary, with milk as a direct strong anchor; it is not used as an obscure trick.

Accept easy. A hammer, pliers and screwdriver are immediately recognizable workshop tools; the qualified dish sponge is cleaning equipment. The clue states their ordinary purpose, not a claim that a sponge can never enter a workshop. The familiar shared tool function uniquely supports the trio, while all items remain useful household objects rather than an arbitrary unrelated intruder.

Accept easy. Hand, finger and leg are parts of the human body; a shirt is clothing. The wording correctly permits a finger, which is not itself a limb. Clothing touches or covers body parts but does not become part of anatomy. Everyday vocabulary and a precise predicate make a fair introductory round; no competing three-item anatomical partition is plausible.

Accept easy but preserve nonstarter status. Plate, bowl and cup are standard vessels used to serve food or drink at the table; a bucket ordinarily carries liquids or materials for household work. All four are containers, so the distinction requires purpose rather than visual material or mere containment. A novelty bucket presentation at a restaurant does not displace the usual category. The missing plate-to-bowl graph edge does not weaken the obvious human predicate, while the original ranking gate correctly keeps this board outside the starter shelf.

Accept easy. Bucket, mop and detergent share direct use in washing a floor; a lamp illuminates. The label names the activity honestly across two implements and a cleaning substance rather than calling everything a tool. Illumination may make any task easier but is not itself washing. The simple functional distinction is uniquely defensible with common household vocabulary.

Accept easy. Thirst-water and son-daughter provide clear anchors; wheelbarrow-garden and pen-schoolbag are familiar work and storage relations. Water can serve a garden, but that exchange leaves thirst without another suitable partner. A son may carry a schoolbag, but then pen and daughter have no comparably specific relationship. The son/daughter label describes family terms without asserting that particular children are siblings. The weaker broad garden relation remains clear once these anchors are recognized, and there is no equal complete alternative.

Accept easy. Hunger-food, saw-tree, dog-yard and blanket-sheet describe needs, cutting, guarding and bedding. Dog-food is a plausible crossing, yet would force hunger-yard or another unsupported leftover; a tree in a yard similarly cannot consume the saw relationship without stranding the dog. The label says a yard can be guarded, not that every dog lives outdoors. Blanket and sheet are both bedding without asserting identical placement. All terms are ordinary and the complete matching is unique.

Accept easy. Leg-ankle, Sun-star, write-notebook and jacket-wardrobe form distinct body, astronomical, school and storage relations. The Sun is itself a star, while the ankle is a lower-limb region; the label does not confuse these two relation types. The ordinary Romanian whole-leg meaning makes picior legible. A notebook can be stored in a wardrobe, but swapping it with the jacket leaves no normal writing partner; isolated incidental associations do not make another complete solution.

Accept easy. Moon-night, butter-biscuit salami, lemon-orange and tooth-toothpaste supply four recognizable pairs. The Moon/night label describes a cultural observational association without excluding daytime visibility. Butter is a documented ingredient of ordinary biscuit-salami variants, not a universal recipe law. Citrus zest could flavor a dessert, but that swap strands the other citrus with butter or toothpaste; the two citrus fruits together are more direct. The complete set has one coherent matching without specialized facts.

Accept easy. Storm, lightning and thunder are familiar atmospheric phenomena; the Moon is an astronomical body beyond the atmosphere. The exact group label avoids claiming that every storm includes thunder or that the Moon cannot appear during daytime. Lightning and thunder are related but remain separate visual and sound phenomena, each satisfying the same predicate. A broad sky theme includes all four, yet does not defeat the narrower, uniquely defensible atmospheric trio. NWS explains thunder as atmospheric air expansion; NASA identifies the Moon as a natural satellite.

Accept easy. Dog-cat provides an immediate familiar-pet anchor, wheat-flour a recognizable milling relation, banana-fruit a food classification, and leaf-branch a plant attachment. Leaf and fruit can both associate with a branch, but swapping them leaves banana with leaf, which has no equally direct meaning. Wheat is a plant and flour a food, yet alternative taxonomy swaps leave the plant-part pair unmatched. The qualifying labels avoid saying all leaves grow on branches or all flour comes from wheat. No specialist or culture-specific knowledge is required; exactly one complete human and native matching is defensible.

Accept easy. Frate, Soră and Unchi are direct kinship terms, whereas the actual displayed Vecini describes residence nearby. Real people may occupy both roles, but the category explicitly asks what the words denote. Figurative brotherhood cannot turn all three kinship labels into residence labels. All four are familiar, their native descriptions agree, and the singular versus plural display does not change the common meaning. No specialist knowledge or hidden location context is needed.

Accept easy. Perete–Tavan is an immediate structural anchor; Metrou–Tramvai is the only pair of vehicles and both use urban rails. A găti directly matches the room for food preparation. Examen–Lecție relates assessment to taught material without implying every lesson ends in an exam. Kitchen also has walls and a ceiling, but pairing it with either strands cooking or leaves the other structural part without an equally direct mate. Generic lessons about cooking or railway exams require invented scenarios, not ordinary direct meanings. No clothing cue invites the dressing sense of găti. Exactly one complete native matching and one defensible ordinary-language partition remain.
